title: Specify the attempt-policy freeze and audit ledger integration seam
body:
## Goal
Prepare a design-only integration contract for the external freeze receipt and append-only dispatch/delivery/audit ledger proposed by the independently CLEAR prospective attempt policy. Expected gain: benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.md and .json specify exact evidence bindings, event transitions and legacy handoff decisions that a later independent reviewer can judge without implementing a provider wrapper. First report the concrete existing seam and compatibility constraints, then propose the contract. This addresses the baseline evidence-integration gap in docs/perpetua/evaluation.md; it does not reopen the closed policy or supply real-envelope authority. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Inspect .session/exports/manifest.json and the three input availabilities first; verify exported #685 report and staged artifact identities. Pin starting commit/tree, actual source hashes and the reviewed policy bytes. Review #685 CLEAR at accepted cf0c84e5b16e8e719ae83af35da7a0c80bed7160/tree 7c204fa6f00d40ef1e057cdcd5ddd8725edda4f5. Confirm Markdown hash 22c837604524677c06e0eaad9410018c1230ce86d0e6cfd767b8f3fcaaa79e39 and JSON hash 15ccbdf618ad86cf477dc2f6a680ad8fdd146cf1ced060de6cd96f77eb9797df. Missing or changed inputs are explicit limitations, never clearance.
- [ ] Read the actual integration_seam and governing identity/accounting contracts selectively. Before proposing changes, record a concise source-linked finding about what existing bytes define and what the external receipt/ledger still needs to define. Do not repeat the general gap survey, policy review, sizing/count design or F2 probes.
- [ ] Add only benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.md and .json as a separately versioned design-only supplement. Specify required receipt/event fields, full immutable slot/comparison/attempt/delivery identities, byte hashes and evidence references, producer/trust provenance, ordering and UTC, reservation/usage reconciliation, and an acyclic policy-manifest-plan-settings-freeze binding. Distinguish declared data, independently verified authority and unavailable evidence. A locally generated hash or append-only claim must not establish trusted provenance. State which checks require unavailable external authority and fail closed.
- [ ] Specify gate inputs, event preconditions, legal transitions and deterministic handoff outputs for preflight, one-at-a-time dispatch, response retention before parsing, rejection/quarantine, unchanged legacy/envelope/grouping checks and final audit. Separate immutable operational terminal history from later audit revisions. Preserve original deliveries and rejected/unplanned submissions without manufacturing valid envelope rows; explicitly report irrecoverable storage/evidence gaps. Specify crash/interruption and incomplete/ambiguous event ordering conservatively without adding resume, retry or delivery-only proof authority. Real-envelope admission remains blocked.
- [ ] Preserve 0148 rules, explicit per-arm repetition mapping, frozen order and stop precedence. Show how consumers derive planned/dispatched/retained-attempt/delivery/missing/unstarted/ineligible/unresolved inventories, conditional structural completion and budget usage without favorable selection, erased history or reduced coverage. Legacy multiple-attempt selection stays unresolved with zero completion; no new legacy enum, schema, scoring denominator or caller boundary. Unknown usage/prices remain unknown and cannot satisfy required ceilings.
- [ ] Reuse #685's saved expectations/comparison as regression inputs rather than rederive or claim blindness. Before applying your proposed contract, save seam-specific expected event/handoff decisions in .session/artifacts/attempt-ledger-expectations-0150.json. Then save a separate application/check artifact with minimal finite synthetic event traces covering intact pairs, ordinary answer failure, hard evidence stop, before/after-dispatch drift, budget failure, trusted versus unproved redelivery, extra/conflicting submissions, last-slot stop, late audit changes and interrupted/unverifiable event persistence. Include explicit differing per-arm repetition labels. Derive trace counts from actual bytes, retain mismatches and label examples synthetic: no actual trusted receipt, provider dispatch or real completion exists.
- [ ] Check every new field/transition against pinned source rules and saved expectations using short direct Python data checks only. Report author consistency separately from independent review. Do not execute any historical checker, runner, scorer, probes, evaluator, model/transport/native request or product code. Do not modify existing contracts/templates/checkers/index/protocol, add executable wrapper code, request owner action, select real settings/counts/quota, or claim readiness. Actual admissions, model/reader/native executions, scored runs, semantic passes and real comparisons remain zero, benchmark_ready=false.
- [ ] Report exact changed files/hashes, source/input pins, findings before proposal, checks and remaining trust/real-envelope prerequisites in .session/report.md. Export the expectation and application/check artifacts for a later separate changed-scope review; leave a precise review handoff. This task authors a new seam contract, not its independent approval.
## Verification
python3 -I -c "import json,pathlib; m=pathlib.Path('benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.md'); p=pathlib.Path('benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.json'); assert m.is_file() and m.stat().st_size>0; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert isinstance(d,dict) and d; print('integration contract files and JSON: OK')"
This repository-only check establishes output existence and JSON syntax, not normative correctness. In-session direct checks must validate the actual new contract and saved examples; the engine cannot read session artifacts.
## Context
Iteration 0149 #685 independently CLEARs the two-file 0148 no-automatic-retry policy, with no findings and no repository changes. Its report explicitly leaves integration separately scoped. The shaper read that report, the delivered Markdown, evaluation.md and roles.md; it has not opened normative JSON or reviewer artifact bodies. The Markdown proposes an external preflight/freeze receipt, per-slot gates, retention before parsing and audit alongside unchanged legacy checks; real-envelope authority remains unresolved. CLEAR closes the policy scope, not this new integration contract, whole-method readiness or owner acceptance. Existing method gaps in trusted resources/isolation, keys/native authority, actual execution/scoring and accepted precision persist.
## Budget
Read .session/exports/manifest.json; exported report #685; staged flat .session/inputs/685-attempt-policy-independent-expectations-0149.json, 685-attempt-policy-independent-comparison-0149.json and 685-attempt-policy-measured-checks-0149.json; benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.md; selected rules/preflight/integration_seam/source_pins in benchmark/baseline/attempt-policy-0148.json; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md baseline/readiness; benchmark/attempt-evidence-0143.md accounting/controls; selected identity/receipt contracts in benchmark/project-run-binding-0138.json and benchmark/baseline/run-manifest.template.json; benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md ordering; benchmark/project-paired-0136.md stopping. For a concrete referenced compatibility issue read at most two further source sections named by those files, explaining why. No whole large JSON, key/payload catalogs, broad history or closed review suites. Keep outputs short; report the source-linked seam finding early. Scope is two new design files plus session artifacts/report, not product implementation or executable benchmark integration.
